claim: On January 22, 2026 Amazon MQ added a JMS topic exchange plugin for brokers on RabbitMQ 4.2 and above. With the official RabbitMQ JMS client it runs JMS workloads on Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ and supports JMS 1.1, 2.0 and 3.1.
question: Can JMS applications run on Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ, and since when?

qualifiers.scope: JMS support on Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ brokers on RabbitMQ 4.2 and above

note: d027. Older exam questions may assume JMS means ActiveMQ and RabbitMQ on Amazon MQ means AMQP 0-9-1 only.
